title: Project provenance
description: Per-project record of what a build was made from and how: the curator decisions, and the exact versions of the ontologies, data sources, software and models used, so results are reproducible and can be re-checked when a source changes (e.g. an FBbt release renames a term). One provenance.json per project. Every entry uses the same field names: `id` is an identifier only (DOI, accession, CURIE, model id, or a short slug), `label` a short human-readable name or title, `type` the kind of thing from the section's list, `description` free text on how or why it was used, `accessed_at` the date it was retrieved or queried.

id.description: An identifier, not a name: DOI, accession (GSE, E-MTAB, FBlc, ...), CURIE, model id, or a short slug (e.g. flybase-chado). No spaces.

label.description: Short human-readable name or title; no notes.

description.description: Free text: what it is, or how / why it was used.

path.description: File name or path as stored (relative to the project or .cache).

project.description: Project directory name this provenance applies to.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 date (or datetime) this record was produced.

summary.description: A short paragraph: what the project is, what was built, and from what.

decisions.description: Curation and build decisions, in date order: the choices a reader needs in order to understand or reproduce the result.

by.description: curator: decided or approved by the curator; pipeline: a build/method choice made in the pipeline.

checks.description: Verifications run on the result (term currency, cross-checks, marker spot checks), with their outcome.

pipeline.description: The code in THIS repo that produced the outputs.

commit.description: Git commit the build ran from.

uncommitted_changes.description: True if the build also included changes not yet committed at that commit (e.g. the outputs being added).

accessed_via.description: How it was queried, e.g. OLS4 API, OLS MCP, local OBO file.

data_sources.description: Publications, datasets and earlier loads the project was built from, with the specific files used.

type.description: publication / preprint (paper, by DOI); dataset (an archive accession: GEO, ArrayExpress); author_files (the authors' own analysis files); previous_load (an earlier VFB/FlyBase load of the dataset, e.g. an FBlc); project (another project in this repo whose entities or mappings are reused).

xrefs.description: Other identifiers for the same thing, as CURIEs (PMID:, PMCID:, FlyBase:FBrf...).

software.description: Tools, libraries, services and code repositories used.
